title: Esther
author: The author is not named.
date: During the Persian period among Jews who remained outside the land.
audience: The Jewish people, showing God's providential preservation even when His name is not directly mentioned.
historicalSetting: Esther records how God preserved His people from destruction through Esther, Mordecai, and a series of providential reversals in Persia.
keyVerse: Esther 4:14 — "Who knows whether you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"
christFocus: Esther points to Christ by showing deliverance through intercession and risk. It preserves the line through which the Messiah would come and reminds us of God's unseen faithfulness.
